notes.title: Full Release Arrived
notes.notes:
Hail Galadanians ! we are finally arrived.

As a solo developer I finally completed this game after 8 years. With the final content of imperial forest, implemented Steam achievements and countless play testing I launched the game as full release. Some language options are auto translated but I am confident with English and Turkish language options. When I find the opportunity I will rework them. I will keep adding small bug fix patches as needed. Now Its time to focus on my second game project with a small team this time. I will announce it when the time comes. 

I sincerely thank you for your support and I promise to make even better games in the future.

notes.title: Grove Update for Version 0.9
notes.notes:
Hail Galadanians !

Update for Grove lands is arrived. With this update new playable zone is activated. 3 new narrative branches, 2 new barracks types, new spell runes, grimoires and many different enemy and combat mechanics are added. Now only 1 last update is left to the full release.

CHANGE LOG:

- Grove lands are now available.
- New elven enemy arsenal.
- New flying enemies.
- Buildable Elven and Dwarven barracks
- New runes and grimoires
- Necromancy path with different army management system
- Performance optimizations
- Bugs about soldier orders and furnature placements are fixed

notes.title: Paragonate Update RELEASED for V 0.75
notes.notes:
Greetings Galadanians ! Last big update before full release is here now. With this update, road to Dwarven Paragonate is open along with new story events, raw materials, weapons, armor, runes, castle upgrades and craftables are at your disposal. After this I will complate work to complete this game entirely so expect full release roughly at the end of this year.

CHANGE LOG:

New Content:
- New 6 Dwarven town with new units, war machines, characters and battle mechanics.
- Upgradable siege explosives for soldiers.
- New upgradable weapons and armor for soldier units.
- New items and craft recipes for Gabu and his castle.
- Perma evil or good mechanic depending on choices.


Bug Fixes:
- Goblin spawning mechanic is re designed.
- Mechanics for spell caster goblins have been completed.
- Fixed a bug where equipping furnatures on castle created visual bug.
- Lighting and shading of scenes and some of the characters has been re done.
- Fixed a bug where a visual lighting glitch was occuring when opening panels in preperation scene.
- Ranged soldiers shooting mechanic is redesigned.

notes.title: Update for Version 0.6
notes.notes:
Hail Galadanians. V0.6 brings the most balanced and clear version of the early access.

CHANGE LOG:

New Features:

- Outpost dynamic has been implemented to Forestshire and Rockshire maps. Now enemy soldiers will spawn from farthest standing outpost. Outposts must be destroyed in order for player to move forward.

- Melee soldiers will move past ranged ones in battle.

- Price of sandstone has been reduced so it will be purchased and used easier.

- Timer added to battle scenes which makes tracking enemy advantage triggers easier.

- Building structures like outposts and enemy castles will reduced damage from melee and magic sources. Soldiers siege grenades now inflict extra damage scaling with their division level. This makes investing into soldiers significantly more important.

- Some crafting items required materials reduced to a more reasonable scale.

- Enemy generals will use much more precise ability attacks when siege of and enemy castle is started.

Bug Fixes:

- Fixed barracks upgrade button tooltip. It shows correct amount of required gold.

- Fixed a bug where archers were keep shooting even after enemy soldier was dead.

- Fixed a bug where causing game to crash when players moving castle was damaged or ruined.

Bug Fixes:

- Fixed a bug where skipping the tutorial prevent recipes to appear correctly.

notes.title: Roadmap to V1.0
notes.notes:
Hail Galadanians ! Today I will tell you about my work plan to reach the full release.

I intend to upload 4 more main updates to complete the entire game. I planned the game to conclude in 5 chapters. First chapter is playable therefore 4 chapters to go. 

Code wise i covered almost all crucial systems therefore I plan to add new content to the game regarding new types of enemies, more airborne units, environmental enemies and unique challenges, new spells and weapons etc.

So now each update mean a new playable chapter with new dynamics.

Since it's a one man project I plan to complete each chapter around 2-3 months maximum.

You can check out the visual content I am creating on my Instagram page: atkgames.official
